3.--(1) There shall be
established an Institute at Karachi, known as the Karachi Institute of Economics

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Powers and functions of the Institute

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
4. Powers and functions of the
Institute.--The Institute shall have the following powers which may be
exercised subject to the instructions of Government--
(a) to provide for instruction
and training in economics, management, basic, applied and computer sciences,
technology and other allied disciplines in such a manner as it considers
appropriate;
(b) to conduct seminars,
conferences, workshops and such other functions which are necessary for
curricular and extra-curricular objectives of the Institute;
(c) to print, publish and
circulate periodicals, journals, magazines and books and disseminate scientific,
technological and other related knowledge and information conducive to the
attainment of any of the objectives of the Institute;
(d) to promote, contact and
establish linkage and affiliate with national and international universities,
institutions and other development organizations within the country and abroad
for effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities;
(e) to provide assistance to
relevant industry, Government institutions and other organizations in the
country and abroad through expert advice, consultations and in any other manner
as it may deem fit;
(f) to undertake joint
investigation and to mobilize qualified staff and collaborative research with
other organizations including universities in the fields of economics, basic
sciences, technology and other allied disciplines;
(g) to pursue and make provisions
for research, innovations, inventions, demonstrations and other services as it
may deem fit;
(h) to admit and examine
students;
(i) to prescribe courses in all
disciplines and hold examinations and to confer or award degrees, diplomas,
certificates, academic research, prizes and distinctions on and to persons who
fulfil the requirements or have passed its examinations in accordance with the
prescribed conditions;
(j) to provide for the teaching
of specified courses and training for persons not being the students of the
Institute and grant certificates and diplomas to such persons;
(k) to recognize the examinations
passed or the period of study spent at other universities or places of
learning, as equivalent to examinations or periods of study in the Institute or
withdraw such recognition;
(1) to create posts for teaching,
research extension, administration, training and for any other purposes related
thereto and appoint persons thereto;
(m) to institute and award
fellowships, scholarships, stipends, bursaries, medals and prizes;
(n) to establish, administer and
maintain halls of residence and approve any place as hostel or lodging for
students;
(o) to supervise and control the
discipline of the students of the Institute, and promote extra-curricular and
recreational activities of such students, and to make arrangements for
promoting their health and general welfare;
(p) to charge and receive such
fee and other payments as it may determine;
(q) to establish and promote
faculties;
(r) to confer honourary degrees;
(s) to enter into agreements,
contracts and arrangements with organizations; bodies and individuals for
carrying out its functions and activities;
(t) to receive and manage
properties, grants, bequests, trusts, gifts, donations, endowments and other
contributions made to the Institute and obtain loan or aid, and to invest them
in such a manner as it may deem fit; and
(u) to do all such other acts and
things as may be required to further its objectives and perform its functions.

Institute shall be open to persons of either sex of whatever religion, race,

denied the privileges of the Institute only on grounds of sex, religion, creed,

sections.description:
Visitation

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
9. Visitation.--(1) The
Patron, may cause an inspection cr inquiry to be made in respect of any matter
connected with the affairs of the Institute and shall from time to time, direct
any person or persons to inquire into or carry out inspection of--
(a) the Institute, its
buildings, laboratories, libraries and other facilities;
(b) any department, school,
centre, division, or hostel maintained by the Institute;
(c) the adequacy of human and
financial resources;
(d) the teachings, research,
curriculum, examination and other matters of the Institute.
(2) The Patron shall communicate
to the Board his views in regard to the results of the visitation and shall
after ascertaining the views thereon of the Board advise the Board on actions
to be taken by it.
(3) The Board shall, within such
tithe as may be specified by the Patron, communicate to him such action, if
any, as has been taken or may be proposed to be taken upon the results of
visitation.
(4) Where the Board does not,
within the time specified, take action to the satisfaction of the Patron, the
Patron may issue such directions as he thinks fit and the Board shall comply
with such directions.
(5) The Patron shall have full
power to take any action as he may deem fit against the Institution, including
its closure, if found indulging in any subversive or unlawful activity.

Chancellor

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000

NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
10. Chancellor.--(1) The
Chancellor shall be a person of eminence, known for his contributions in the
field of knowledge or service to society and appreciated for his high moral and
intellectual calibre.
(2) The Chancellor shall be
appointed by the Patron in consultation with the society on such terms and
conditions as may be determined by the Board.
(3) If the Chancellor is
satisfied that the proceedings of any Authority or orders of an Officer are not
in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance, regulations or rules,- he
may after calling upon such authority or officer to show cause why such
proceedings should not be annulled and by order in writing annul such
proceedings or orders.
(4) In the absence of the patron,
the Chancellor shall preside over the convocation.
(5) Should the Chancellor be
incapacitated from acting as such due to illness or any other cause, the
Chairman shall act for him.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
11. President.--(1) The
Chancellor shall appoint a person of eminence in the field of education,
administration, finance with experience in Government, private sector, as the
President and Vice-Presidents on such terms and conditions as may be determined
by the Chancellor.
(2) The President shall---
(i) control and supervise the
activities of the Institute connected with teaching, training, . research,
inventions, innovations, demonstrations, administration and other services;
(ii) appoint, teachers and other
officers and staff of the Institute, and such other persons, as may be
necessary, in accordance with the regulations;
(iii) sanction all expenditures
within the approved budget;
(iv) sanction by re-appropriation
an amount not exceeding a sum specified in the rules and regulations for an
unforeseen item, not provided for in the budget with the approval of the
Society and report it to the Board;
(v) create and fill temporary
posts for a period not exceeding six months;
(vi) engage experts and
consultants as may be required, for efficient and effective discharge of the
functions of the Institute;
(vii) constitute from amongst the
officers and staff of the Institute such committees, sub-committees and working
groups as he may deem necessary;
(viii) ensure the implementation
of provisions of this Ordinance, regulations, rules and directives of the
Board.
(ix) perform such other functions
and exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to him by the
Board; and
(x) delegate any of his powers to
appropriate levels of management subject to such conditions as he may deem 6t
to impose.
(3) A Vice-President shall
exercise such powers and perform such functions as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Constitution of the Board

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
13. Constitution of the Board.--(1)
The, general administration and supervision shall vest in the Board consisting
of:-
(a) Air Marshal Azim Doudpota
shall be the life Chairman;
(b) The Chancellor;
(c) The President of the
Institute;
(d) The Chairman, University
Grants Commission or his nominee;
(e) A Judge of High Court
nominated by Chief Justice of Sindh;
(f) The Secretary Education, or
his nominee;
(g) One Dean nominated by the
Chairman;
(h) The President, Karachi
Chamber of Commerce and Industry;
(i) Vice-Presidents of the
Institute;
(j) Five members of the Society
nominated by the Society;
(k) Six distinguished persons
known for their contribution and experience in the field of education, banking,
finance or any other. field of interest nominated by the Society;
(1) Secretary of the Society.
(2) Should the life Chairman be
incapacitated from acting as such due to absence or any other cause, the
Chancellor shall act for him.
(3) A member nominated by the
Society shall unless removed earlier hold office for a term of three years and
shall be eligible for re nomination after expiry of his term.
(4) The office of a member
nominated by the Society shall become vacant if he resigns or fails to attend
three consecutive meetings of the Board without sufficient cause or leave of
absence.
(5) No act or proceedings of the
Board shall be invalid by reason only of the existence of a vacancy in or any
defect in the constitution of the Board.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Powers and functions of the Board

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
14. Powers and functions of
the Board.--The Board shall exercise and perform the following powers and
functions--
(a) to hold, control and
administer the property, fund and resources of the Institute and borrow or
raise money for the purpose of the Institute upon such securities as may be
required;
(b) to hold, control or dispose
and administer any movable or immovable property of the Institute;
(c) to create new components of
the Institute such as schools, departments, faculty, division or any other
teaching or research unit;
(d) to formulate or approve
long-term strategy, policies and plans governing the activities and operation
of the Institute so as to ensure its autonomy in teaching research and other
academic work;
(e) to approve the annual budget
of the Institute;
(f) to call for annual, biannual
or quarterly progress report relating to the activities of the Institute an
execution of the approved work plans to review the progress and issue direction
to the concerned authorities for the execution of works;
(g) to create such administrative
or academic posts on specified terms and conditions;
(h) to ensure financial viability
of the Institute and effectiveness of its operations and confirming
preservation of the autonomy of the Institute;
(i) to appoint such committees or
sub-committees for such work as it may deem necessary;
(j) to delegate any of its powers
to the President, Vice-President or such other officers subject to such
conditions as it may deem fit to impose;
(k) to approve rules on the
recommendations of the appropriate body.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000

ORDINANCE V OF 2000

15. Meetings of the Board.--(1)
The Board shall meet at least twice a year on dates to be fixed by the
Chairman:
Provided that a special meeting
may be called at any time at the request of not less than five members of the
Board, to consider any matter of an urgent nature.
(2) The quorum for a meeting of
the Board shall be one-half of its members, a fraction being counted as one.
(3) The decisions of the Board
shall be expressed in terms of the view of the majority of the members present
and voting, and in case of equality of votes the Chairman shall have right to
exercise a casting vote.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Academic Council

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
17. Academic Council.--(1)
The Academic Council, shall consist of:--
(a) The President shall be the
Chairman;
(b) the Deans;
(c) the Heads of the teaching
departments;
(d) two Associate Professors,
nominated by the President;
(e) one Assistant Professor or
Lecturer, nominated by the President;
(f) one eminent scholar nominated
by the Board;
(g) two persons of eminence in
the field of education nominated by the Society;
(h) one member of the society
nominated by the Society;.
(i) one nominee of the Secretary
Education Government of Sindh, not below the rank of Additional Secretary;
(j) the Director-General Regional
Office of the University Grants Commission; and
(k) the Vice-President nominated
by the President shall be the Secretary.
(2) A nominated member shall hold
office for a term of two years and shall be eligible for re-nomination.
(3) The office of a nominated
member shall become vacant if he resigns or fails to attend three consecutive
meetings of the council, without sufficient cause or leave of absence, or the
nominating authority changes his nomination.
(4) The quorum for a meeting of
the Academic Council shall be one third of the total number of members, a
fraction being counted as one.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Powers and functions of the Academic Council

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
18. Powers and functions of
the Academic Council.--(1) The Academic Council shall be the Academic Body
of the Institute, and shall, subject to the provisions of this Ordinance and
the regulations, have the powers to lay down proper standards of instructions,
research and examinations, and to
regulate and promote the academic life of the institute.
(2) In particular, and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing provisions, the Academic Council
shall have the powers--
(a) to advise the Board on
academic matters;
(b) to propose to the Board,
scheme for the constitution and organization of faculties, teaching departments
and Boards of Studies;
(c) to regulate the admission of
students to the courses of studies and holding of examination;
(d) to consider or formulate
proposals for the planning and development of teaching and research in the
Institute;
(e) to recognize the examination
of other institutes, universities or examining bodies as equivalent to the
corresponding examinations of the Institute;
(f) to frame rules for submission
to the Board;
(g) to make rules prescribing the
course of studies, the syllabi and the outlines of tests for all examinations
the Institute shall conduct, subject to the approval of the Board;
(h) to appoint members to the
various authorities in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance;
(i) to regulate the conduct and
discipline of the students of the Institute;
(j) to regulate the award of
medals and prizes;
(k) to perform such other
functions as may be prescribed by the regulations.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Regulations

ORDINANCE V OF 2000
KARACHI INSTITUTE OF
ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE V OF 2000
An
Ordinance to provide for the establishment of an Institute at Karachi known as
Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 24th May, 2000]
NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated
24-7-2000. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-----
19. Regulations.--(1)
Subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, the Board may make regulations
which may prescribe all or any of the following matters namely;--- "
(a) terms and conditions of
service of employees of the Institute, including scales of pay, constitution of
pension, insurance, gratuity, provident fund, benevolent fund and other fringe
benefits;
(b) terms and conditions of
contractual appointment of teachers, researchers and officers;
(c) constitution and functions of
the Selection Board for selection of candidates for appointment to various
posts of teachers and other officers and staff;
(d) establishment of faculties,
teaching departments and other academic units and divisions and their
management;
(e) powers and duties of officers
and teachers;
(f) conditions under which the
Institute may enter into arrangements, partnership, collaboration with other
public, government or private organizations for purpose of instruction,
research and other scholarly activities for the betterment of the Institute;
(g) condition of appointment of
Professor Emeritus and Distinguished Professors;
(h) award of honourary degrees;
(i) standards for evaluation of
efficiency and exercising disciplinary measures over the employees of the
Institute;
(j) acquisition and
administration of properties and investment of the Institute; and
(k) all other matter which under
this Ordinance are required to be or may be prescribed by the regulations.
(2) The draft of the regulations
shall be proposed by the Board for approval by the Chancellor who may reefer
them back to the Board for` reconsideration.
(3) The Chancellor shall have the
powers to assent to the regulations submitted to him for, approval.
(4) No regulation shall be valid
until assented to and signed by the Chancellor.

sections.description:

NO.S.LEGIS.1(5)/2000, dated

published for general information:-----
21. Institute fund, audit and
accounts.--(1) The Institute shall have a fund to which shall be credited
income from fees, donations, trusts, bequests, endowments, grants,
contributions or any other sources.
(2) No contribution, donation or
grant which may directly or indirectly involve any immediate or subsequent
financial liability of the Institute or which may involve an activity not
included in its programme for the time being shall not be accepted without the
prior approval of the Society.
(3) The accounts of the Institute
shall be maintained in such form and in such manner as ma be prescribed b
regulations.
(4) The accounts of the Institute
shall be audited each year within four months of the closing of the financial
year by a Chartered Accountant appointed by the Society.
(5) The accounts, together with
the report of the auditor thereon, shall be submitted to the Society for
approval.
(6) The auditor's report shall
certify that the auditor has complied with the standards of the audit and
certification laid down by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan.
